item.title: Starmind (satellite)
item.description: Starmind is a planned constellation of solar-powered space-based AI data center satellites in development by SpaceX as of 2026. The first satellite design is called AI1. The satellite will be inserted into a sun-synchronous orbit in order to remain constantly in the sunlight. The satellite aims to overcome building, energy and cooling restraints on Earth. SpaceX has filed for 1 million Starmind satellites at the FCC.
